tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: 淡墨纸 Pale Manuscript — the base canvas of every page, slide and report.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: 宣纸 Paper — raised content: cards, tables, dialogs on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-primary
tokens.usage: 素墨 Ink — the primary brand colour: input fields and the primary button fill (with a `gold` hairline). `ink-muted` on it is 4.49:1, just under 4.5 — keep secondary text off this field.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: 玄墨 Charcoal — titles and primary text: 16.3:1 on `surface`, 18.2:1 on `paper`. Also the single inverse card per section; never a page ground.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: 土金 Earth Gold — rules, strokes, navigation, control borders and the focus ring. 6.0:1 on `surface` (text-safe). Never a fill.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: 明金 Bright Gold — active state and key numbers 28px+ only. 1.9:1 on `surface`: never body-size text on pale; pair with a `charcoal` or `gold-deep` label, or set on `charcoal` (8.4:1). Chart series 1.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: 深金 Deep Gold — captions, EN labels, eyebrows and the tagline 智慧领航者 at every size. Same hex as `gold`, kept as its own token (ruling Q3 v0.7). 6.0:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: 素墨灰 Ink Muted — secondary text: 4.9:1 on `surface`, 5.5:1 on `paper`. Chart axes.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: 朱红 Vermillion — the seal, negation (✕) and warnings; ≤5% of any view, never a fill for positive data. 7.1:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: parchment-50
tokens.usage: Lightest parchment tint — emphasized card ground (`surface-card-muted`), text on accent.

tokens.name: parchment-100
tokens.usage: Parchment tint — alternate page band (`surface-page-alt`) and selected-row fill.

tokens.name: parchment-150
tokens.usage: = `surface`; ramp step kept for component code.

tokens.name: parchment-200
tokens.usage: = `ink-primary` 素墨; ramp step kept for component code.

tokens.name: parchment-300
tokens.usage: Sunken surface (`surface-sunken`) and the primary button pressed fill.

tokens.name: parchment-400
tokens.usage: Parchment ramp step — dividers on sunken grounds.

tokens.name: parchment-500
tokens.usage: Deepest parchment step — rarely used; decorative only, not text.

tokens.name: gold-100
tokens.usage: Gold tint — primary button hover fill, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Mid gold — the gold half of the two-tone wordmark (`text-wordmark-gold`). 3.1:1 on `surface`: large text and marks only.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: = `gold` 土金; the step accent numerals use for text-safe contrast.

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Hover — one step darker than `gold` (8.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for gold rules, links, secondary and nav controls.

tokens.name: gold-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state for gold controls (with a 1px translateY stamp).

tokens.name: bronze-100
tokens.usage: Retained pre-v0.7 alias — light bronze tint; write new code against `gold-*`.

tokens.name: bronze-200
tokens.usage: Retained pre-v0.7 alias — selection highlight; write new code against `gold-*`.

tokens.name: bronze-300
tokens.usage: Retained pre-v0.7 alias — mid bronze; write new code against `gold-*`.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Neutral — disabled marks and chart grid labels at large size (3.4:1 on `surface`); not body text.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Neutral — decorative rules on parchment; not text.

tokens.name: seal-300
tokens.usage: Light vermillion — secondary seal mark; not text.

tokens.name: growth-500
tokens.usage: 增长 — report charts only, when growth must be told apart from 关注. 5.3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: growth-200
tokens.usage: 增长 tint — report chart fills.

tokens.name: loss-500
tokens.usage: 利润流失 = 朱红 — report charts only.

tokens.name: loss-200
tokens.usage: 利润流失 tint — report chart fills.

tokens.name: caution-500
tokens.usage: 关注 — report charts only; 2.7:1 on `surface`, so marks not text.

tokens.name: caution-200
tokens.usage: 关注 tint — report chart fills.

tokens.name: datum-500
tokens.usage: 中性数据 — report charts only; 5.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: datum-200
tokens.usage: 中性数据 tint — report chart fills.

tokens.name: chart-benchmark
tokens.usage: Benchmark / 基准 lines and design values in charts.

tokens.name: chart-functional
tokens.usage: Functional chart marks (targets, cuts) in 土金.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Card ground = `paper`, with a `line-card` hairline and no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-card-muted
tokens.usage: Emphasized card ground (with a gold top rule).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The single charcoal card per section; never a page ground.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and accent text on `surface` / `paper`.

tokens.name: text-tagline
tokens.usage: The tagline 智慧领航者, at every size, `.5em` tracking.

tokens.name: text-key
tokens.usage: Key numbers 28px+ beside a labelling text, or on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: text-wordmark-gold
tokens.usage: Wordmark rule: the gold letters I · NSIGHT of TIANSIGHT on light grounds (gold-400, weight 400). Pair with `text-wordmark-ink` on T and A; never set the wordmark in one flat colour. 3.1:1 on `surface`: display sizes only.

tokens.name: text-wordmark-ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark rule: the ink letters T and A of TIANSIGHT on light grounds, weight 700. Pairs with `text-wordmark-gold`.

tokens.name: text-wordmark-gold-inverse
tokens.usage: Wordmark on charcoal or photo grounds: the gold letters I · NSIGHT (6.3:1 on `charcoal`).

tokens.name: text-wordmark-ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Wordmark on charcoal or photo grounds: the ink letters T and A, weight 700.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse-key
tokens.usage: Key numbers on the charcoal card (8.4:1).

tokens.name: text-negative
tokens.usage: Negation and warning text (✕, 利润流失).

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Internal dividers, table rows, chart grid.

tokens.name: line-rule
tokens.usage: Stronger separations; hover state of a card border.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Form control borders (3:1+ on every ground).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline at 2px offset; always visible.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: 侍天 lockup and hero claim. Fluid in code: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem) = 48–96px; 300–400 weight reads airier at 48px+.

styles.name: type-h1
styles.usage: Page title. Fluid in code: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.5rem) = 36–56px. One h1 per page.
styles.sample: 从一道菜，到一家家店的好生意。

styles.name: type-h2
styles.usage: Section headline — two verb phrases split by a comma. Fluid in code: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem) = 28–40px.
styles.sample: 开店之前，把生意想清楚。

styles.name: type-h3
styles.usage: Card and sub-section titles; a short verb phrase.

styles.name: type-body
styles.usage: Body copy in `text-body`; measure 36em (28–38 CN characters).
styles.sample: 菜单，是餐厅向顾客发出的购买邀请，也是每天都在执行的经营决策。

styles.name: type-small
styles.sample: 每个建议明确依据、动作与验证方式。

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: EN labels and eyebrows: UPPERCASE, `.34em` tracking, `text-caption`.

styles.name: type-mono
styles.usage: Hex, tokens, data strings and prices — tabular figures.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: TIANSIGHT set in type: uppercase, `.34em` tracking. T and A in `text-wordmark-ink` at 700, I · NSIGHT in `text-wordmark-gold` at 400 (use the `Wordmark` component). Never one flat colour.

styles.name: quote-latin
styles.usage: Latin taglines and pull quotes in Noto Serif italic.
styles.sample: Time is money. With TIANSIGHT, lose neither.

styles.name: numeral-key
styles.usage: KPI numerals in IBM Plex Mono; `gold-500` on pale, `text-key` only at 28px+ beside a label or on charcoal.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding; seal gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: mark-min-hero
tokens.usage: Minimum seal size in a hero.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Outline status badges and the WeChat CTA only.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Gold rule under section headings; selected rule.

tokens.name: border-heavy
tokens.usage: Emphasized top edge of a highlighted plan card; focus ring.

tokens.name: tracking-tagline
tokens.usage: The tagline 智慧领航者 at every size.

tokens.usage: Standard easing; no bounce, no spring.
